scripts.start: npm run db:up && npm run build --workspaces --if-present && concurrently -n server,web "npm run start -w apps/server" "npm run preview -w apps/web"
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w apps/server" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.setup: npm run db:up && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
